title: Independent Roadmark road-scooter integration audit
scope: Read-only actual catalogue reader audit of five standard Australian configurations against captured evidence; no app edits or new web/physical-stock verification. Source publication assertions remain conditional.

detail.detail: All three exact AU model pages describe Bluetooth phone unlock, Ride App live vehicle stats, OTA firmware and a 5-inch display. Current shared rows stay unknown. An exact sourced alias can describe only these functions, not passive unlock, full-vehicle OTA or HUD.

Exact E300SE AU page lists AirLock, password unlock, app vehicle information/remote control, OTA, and an LED dashboard. Current shared rows stay unknown. Verify current service/subscription limits before adding aliases.

Conditional mapped facts already contain qualified charge times and named dealer/distributor price bases, while shared rows remain unknown. Do not infer wall AC input/included charger or a nationally comparable price.

Shared unknown rows still include ANCAP, child seats, cabin features, boot and towing. No inherited nonnull values detected. A class-appropriate display could hide irrelevant rows; this audit does not infer these features unavailable.
